items.title: 13.2.3 Nature of Excretory Products in relation to Habitat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nitrogenous wastes and habitat (PDF 6-7).

blocks.text: Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation jism se metabolic fuzlaat (metabolic wastes, jism ke kimiyai amal se bane bekaar madde) nikalne ke saath juri hui hai. Nitrogen wale fuzlaat (nitrogenous wastes, maslan ammonia, urea, uric acid) sab se aham metabolic fuzlaat hain. Yeh fuzlaat pani mein ghol kar nikale jate hain. Mukhtalif maskanon (habitats, rehne ki jagah) ke janwar nitrogen wale fuzlaat ki mukhtalif shaklen nikalte hain. Maslan:

Jab amino acids aur nucleic acids se amino group (-NH₂) alag kiya jata hai aur woh H⁺ se mil jata hai to jigar (liver) mein ammonia (NH₃) banti hai. Ammonia bohat zehreeli (highly toxic) hai, is liye ise jaldi nikalna parta hai. Ek gram ammonia ko be-zarar (nontoxic) had tak patla karne ke liye 500 mL pani chahiye. Itna zyada pani sirf meethe pani ke janwar kharch kar sakte hain, maslan zyada tar machhliyan, protozoans, sponges aur coelenterates. Samundari janwar ammonia seedha pani mein chhor dete hain. Jo janwar apna bara nitrogen wala fuzla ammonia ki shakal mein nikalte hain unhen ammonotelic kehte hain.

Khushki ke janwaron ko pani bachane ka masla hota hai, is liye yeh ammonia ko bohat se pani ke saath nahin nikal sakte. Yeh ammonia ko jigar mein urea mein badalte hain aur phir urea ko gurdon (kidneys) ke zariye nikalte hain. Urea ammonia se kam zehreeli hai. Ek gram urea ko be-zarar had tak patla karne ke liye 50 mL pani chahiye. Jo janwar apna bara nitrogen wala fuzla urea ki shakal mein nikalte hain unhen ureotelic kehte hain.

blocks.title: Insaan aur uric acid
blocks.text: Insaan bhi peshab mein thora sa uric acid nikalte hain. Uric acid purines ke tootne se banne wala zimni madda (by-product) hai; purines bohat si ghizaon mein hote hain, khaas taur par gosht aur kuch sabziyon mein. Uric acid jigar mein banta hai. Sehatmand logon mein banne wala zyada tar uric acid peshab mein nikal jata hai, lekin jab khoon mein uric acid zyada ho jaye to joron (joints) aur tissues mein uric acid ke crystals ban sakte hain, jin se gout jaisi dardnaak bimari hoti hai.

Kuch janwar, jaise insects, registani janwar, birds aur zyada tar reptiles, khushk (arid) mahol ki wajah se pani bachane ke bohat bare masle ka saamna karte hain. Yeh urea bhi nahin nikal sakte. Yeh bohat si tawanai laga kar ammonia ko uric acid mein badalte hain. Uric acid urea se bhi kam zehreela hai. Yeh pani mein kam ghulta hai aur thos zarre (precipitates) bana leta hai. Ek gram uric acid nikalne ke liye sirf 1 mL pani chahiye. Jo janwar uric acid nikalte hain unhen uricotelic kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse nitrogeni fuzle ko nikalne ke liye sab se zyada pani chahiye, aur kaunsa sab se kam zehreela hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ko sab se zyada pani chahiye (fi gram taqreeban 500 mL); uric acid sab se kam zehreela aur taqreeban na-hal hai. Ammonia jigar mein urea banti hai.

items: Ammonia (NH₃): sab se zehreeli, fi gram 500 mL pani; meethe pani ke janwar; ammonotelic.
Urea (CO(NH₂)₂): kam zehreeli, fi gram 50 mL pani; khushki ke janwar; ureotelic.
Uric acid (C₅H₄N₄O₃): sab se kam zehreela, fi gram sirf 1 mL pani, banane mein zyada tawanai; insects, birds, reptiles; uricotelic.
Insaan mein zyada uric acid se joron mein crystals ban kar gout hota hai.
